user.title: Add YKKApSmartLock
user.description: Enter the lock's BLE address. The official phone must already be bound to this lock.

bluetooth.title: Add {name}
bluetooth.description: The lock was found over Bluetooth. The official phone must already be bound to it.

register.title: Register YKKApSmartLock
register.description: On the official phone, open ordinary-device registration mode for {address}. Then enable Ready and continue. The integration will request 0x52, request a new ordinary smartphoneId with 0x51, and optionally exit with 0x54.

data.ready: The lock is in ordinary-device registration mode

error.invalid_address: Enter a valid BLE MAC address or platform Bluetooth UUID.
error.not_ready: Open ordinary-device registration mode on the official phone first.
error.registration_failed: Registration failed. Check that the official phone is bound, the lock is in registration mode, and Home Assistant can connect over BLE.

abort.not_connectable: This Bluetooth adapter can see the lock but cannot connect to it.
abort.missing_device: The Bluetooth device information is missing.

register_device.name: Register ordinary BLE device
register_device.description: Register this Home Assistant Bluetooth central after the official phone has opened ordinary-device registration mode.

request_adv_key.name: Request advertising key
request_adv_key.description: Request and retain the 16-byte advertising key returned by command 0x10.

exit_registration.name: Exit registration mode
exit_registration.description: Send command 0x54 after the new smartphone slot is assigned.
